title: One-hour KEXINIT initiation proxy under a controlled OpenSSH profile
natural_language: 显式配置一小时 rekey_interval，认证完成、当前不在 KEX、peer 允许 rekey 且已有可发送 packet 时，本地应在一小时内发起 KEXINIT 或连接已关闭。
standard_excerpt: keys be changed after each gigabyte or after each hour
pointwise_semantics: strict pointwise; finite word; absolute integer milliseconds
finite_end_semantics: trace extends beyond the largest bounded obligation; missing AP=false

ap_definitions.ssh_rekey_eligible_one_hour_profile: Authenticated OpenSSH connection has rekey_interval=3600, is not already in KEX, peer permits rekey, and a packet-processing opportunity exists.
ap_definitions.ssh_local_kexinit_started: The local endpoint actually begins KEXINIT for the next key exchange.
ap_definitions.ssh_connection_closed: The correlated SSH transport closes before the local initiation deadline.

correlation_key: OpenSSH ssh/session_state pointer + connection tuple; packet sequence counters remain fields
projection_rule: correlate first, then project one connection/transaction/flight; dynamic identifiers never enter AP names
instrumentation_timing: Configure RekeyLimit with a one-hour interval; emit start when the time predicate returns true and kex_start_rekex is called.
review_question: ProFuzzBench OpenSSH 默认 rekey_interval=0；请确认实验显式配置 RekeyLimit default 1h，并把该差异列为 baseline modification。
limitations: This is a controllable local-initiation proxy, not proof that new keys were installed; peer stall/completion is classified separately and no RFC-equivalence claim is made.
independent_audit_note: Retitled and weakened to a local KEXINIT proxy with all OpenSSH branch preconditions; not presented as completed key change.
